signedOut.label: bb account sign-in
signedOut.reason: Signing in links this machine to a getbb.app identity and credential. Cape keeps bb signed out; a sign-in is revoked and cleared.

disabledPlugins.label: bb account
disabledPlugins.reason: The bb-account plugin owns sign-in and the `bb account` CLI; with it disabled, nothing in bb can sign in.

disabledPlugins.label: bb cloud AI
disabledPlugins.reason: bb cloud AI sends thread content, diffs, and voice audio to getbb.app for titles, commit messages, and transcription.

disabledPlugins.label: bb connect
disabledPlugins.reason: bb connect relays remote access to this machine through a bb-hosted service.
